lock_accounting.policy: For all three ShareHash variants, subtract lock-object bytes from raw reported and estimated heap bytes; retain raw columns for auditing.
lock_accounting.sharehash_subtable: (total slot capacity + T table locks) * sizeof(SpinLock)
lock_accounting.sharehash_pagepool: (slot capacity + T table locks + 1 budget lock) * sizeof(SpinLock)
lock_accounting.other_hashmaps: No deduction; zero does not imply absence of internal locks.
lock_accounting.retained: Padding, pointer fields and allocator metadata remain; RSS and timing are actual measurements with locks executing.

budget_diagnostics_policy: V2-A after-insert ledger includes locks; finite physical cap is not configured (size_t max). Partial workloads are failures, with stored-key ratios retained only as diagnostics.

sharehash_pagepool.additive_policy: automatic object plus initial owned storage
sharehash_pagepool.physical_limit_policy: default size_t max, no finite external cap

summary_policy: Median numeric metrics from numeric CSV rows, including rows with correctness failures; inspect correctness_pass_count and success/hit minima.
memory_summary_policy: Median after-insert numeric metrics, including samples from processes that later fail; inspect insert_success_check_count and completed_read_check_count before interpreting samples as valid indexes.
